what: The clay face kit's head as data (art #42): the pack head reshaped into the faces lab's egg-like bean head before the kit's features are seated on it, in the lab's order (order). nose_flatten pushes the pack nose back into the face (heads.flatten_nose); bean is the space warp onto a superellipsoid about the eye height (heads.bean_warp; hair_k: the hair and every head extra move with their nearest head vertices); rigid_margin is the margin under the kit's lowest mouth point down to which the face skin follows the Head bone alone (clayface/face.py rigid_full_z). Metres, the face toward -Y, world space at rest before the clay look's head scale. Read by tools/blender/um/clayface/kit.py (docs/faces.md, "The bean head").
